messages.content: I’ll build the day-ahead book around the valuable morning reserves, then adjust battery energy at each watch as prices and grid notices arrive.

The overnight controller discharged 15.87 MWh to make room for stronger-than-projected regulation-down delivery. I’m reducing planned discharge to stay within the 75 MWh daily cap and preserve the remaining capacity for the evening.
